items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: And I had a sextet with -- who'd I have? Dick Hyman and Della Lowe and Tony Scott, Joe Mangini, drummer and myself.

ctx.x: So I used to have to come back to New York to work, because at that time, Joe Glazer was booking me. And I had a sextet with -- who'd I have? Dick Hyman and Della Lowe and Tony Scott, Joe Mangini, drummer and myself.
